comments.body:
Research record for this epic (experiments on origin/main 083620b0; venv Python 3.12, mcp 1.29.0, pydantic 2.13.4; prototypes ran against a `git archive origin/main` export because the local editable install trails main).

Corrections to the original brief, verified: `check_mcp_models.py` is `src/rebar/schemas/check_mcp_models.py` (174 LOC; CI step `.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:765-773`; `pyproject.toml:583`); the coverage test is `tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_output_schema_coverage.py` (396 LOC). The 21 `mcp_server.py` re-exports are already gone (commit e5bda753); the residue is `tests/interfaces/facades/test_internal_shim_removal_e54e_heldout.py:39-46`, which still imports `_mcp_models`. 13 tools (not 16) lack an `outputSchema`: `audit_trail, bridge_projects_list, explain_criterion, reopen_ticket, review_code, review_plan, review_plan_start, run_workflow, scan_spec, sign_review, transition_ticket, verify_completion, verify_completion_start`; 16 is the `mcp_only` count. `tests/unit/test_mcp_library_parity.py` is 486 LOC. `tool_annotation_presets()` lives in `_mcp_models.py:585-619` and is imported by all three registrars; deleting the module rehomes it (into `_mcp_schema.py`).

Experiment 1 (annotation census over `rebar.__all__` with `inspect.signature`): 61 functions, 84 unannotated params (61 `repo_root=None` plus 23 others); the full annotation table is the annotation story's description. `scripts/gen_api_surface.py:93-108` records only `[name, kind, default]` plus the return annotation, so `tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json` does not change. 30 of 34 return annotations name `rebar.types` TypedDicts imported only under `TYPE_CHECKING`, so `inspect.signature(fn, eval_str=True)` raises `NameError`; the derivation factory resolves hints itself.

Experiment 2 (32 pydantic models vs `schemas/*.json`): 20 mapped, 12 unmapped; 20 invented nullabilities, 11 dropped enums, 5 relaxed required sets, 2 `additionalProperties` disagreements; the itemised amendment list is the schema story's first comment. Wire measurement over a real `build_server().call_tool`: `show_ticket` 44 keys / 12 nulls on the wire vs 36 / 6 from the library; write acks carry five `push_status` nulls where the library returns `{"state":"ok"}`. Decision: emit exactly what the library returns; absent stays absent (the rule bug 3a02 already applied to 15 properties); the SDK validates `structuredContent` against the advertised schema at call time so a non-null-typed field must be absent, not null. Mechanism proven by prototype: `-> dict[str, Any]` gets a pass-through `RootModel`, `-> list[dict[str, Any]]` wraps as `{"result": [...]}`, and setting `fn_metadata.output_schema` to an inlined canonical schema makes `list_tools()` advertise it and the lowlevel validator accept absent optionals; inlining is mandatory because `jsonschema.validate` cannot resolve cross-file `$ref`s.

Experiment 3 (48 library-backed tools: 26 read, 22 write): 0 of 48 descriptions equal the library docstring; beyond `repo_root` stripping and the 10 manifest-declared divergences, eight input contracts differ (`list_tickets.full/priority`, `bridge_run.profile`, `set_file_impact.impact`, `set_verify_commands.commands`, `sign_manifest.manifest`, `attach_commits.commits`, `summary.ticket_ids`, `transition_ticket` order); all are transport policy and live in the override table (derivation story, first comment).

Child stories created (chain S1 -> S2 -> S3):
- S1 bossy-poetic-polliwog (18f1-f25d-0337-4a06): annotate the 84 library parameters.
- S2 quilted-nepotic-kitty (9835-95f2-3072-4dc1): canonical outputSchemas, delete the pydantic mirror and drift gate, release note; depends on S1.
- S3 masonic-excusable-guppy (c296-4bc7-26be-489d): derive the 48 tools, delete the parity gate, ADR 0118; depends on S2.

Cross-epic: S2 loads `plan_review_status.schema.json` as-is (its enum edits belong to the LLM-leftovers epic winded-chunky-sheldrake); no other epic edits `_mcp_*.py`. Baseline maintenance: S2 removes a `ci_gate` workflow step and S3 removes `scripts/check_mcp_library_parity.py`, so each runs `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --update-stale` in its change (operator-sanctioned; precedent commit 81da792).

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
The MCP server hand-copies two contracts the codebase already owns. Its 48 library-backed tools are closures that re-declare each `rebar.*` signature (`src/rebar/_mcp_reads.py`, `_mcp_writes.py`), guarded only by a name-level parity script, test, and 919-line manifest that cannot see shape drift (three undeclared input divergences exist today). Its output shapes are 32 pydantic models in `src/rebar/_mcp_models.py` (619 LOC) mirroring `src/rebar/schemas/*.json`, policed by `check_mcp_models.py` and 339 LOC of drift tests; bug lowly-lawrencium-ovenbird (3a02-66ea-9229-470c) still found 41 drifted properties and schema-violating nulls on the wire. Ticket topaz-blubbery-mice (c996-8a5f-5123-4f8e) rejected generated adapters for all three surfaces; the operator ruled (2026-09-06) to override that for MCP only, in stages, with an ADR (0118) that supersedes the clause for MCP and leaves the CLI under ADR 0100. Experiments on origin/main 083620b0 (recorded in the stories) confirmed the FastMCP mechanism for advertising canonical schemas, measured the null-vs-absent wire delta, and enumerated every deliberate divergence for the override table.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every public library callable in `rebar.__all__` has a complete parameter annotation. Checked by the census test in the annotation story.
- [ ] Every MCP tool that advertises an `outputSchema` advertises the canonical `src/rebar/schemas/*.json` content verbatim, results carry only what the library emits, and `rebar._mcp_models` plus `check_mcp_models.py` and their drift tests no longer exist. Checked by the diff and wire tests in the schema story.
- [ ] The 48 library-backed tools are produced by one factory from the annotated signatures plus an explicit override table, with input schemas, descriptions, and annotations byte-identical to the pre-derivation server; the name-only parity script, test, and manifest are deleted. Checked by the golden-surface test in the derivation story.
- [ ] ADR 0118 records the MCP-only supersession of topaz-blubbery-mice's no-generated-adapters clause, and release notes list every field that was null and is now absent. Checked by the ADR gates and the release-notes review in `make verify`.

## Child decomposition
- S1 annotate the 84 unannotated library parameters: criterion 1.
- S2 advertise canonical JSON schemas and delete the pydantic mirror: criterion 2 and the release-notes half of criterion 4; depends on S1.
- S3 derive the 48 tools from the annotated signatures, delete the parity gate, write ADR 0118: criterion 3 and the ADR half of criterion 4; depends on S2.
